snippet.title: Aphelion Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Aphelion is a mystery-tinged intergalactic action-adventure where you fight to survive on a frozen planet. A new trailer aired during the Spring Showcase, showcasing more gameplay and nodding towards the game's release date of April 28. It's coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox, and pre-orders are available now.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966410/Aphelion/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
